name: Clinical trials in Australia
description: Australian MND clinical-trials page listing currently recruiting and active/not recruiting trials, Australian site locations, phases where shown and links to trial details.
care_team_notes: Keep answers informational and current to retrieval date; advise people to discuss eligibility, risks, burden and suitability with their neurologist or MND clinic.

name: MND Australia research grants program
description: Overview of Australian MND research funding, grant types, research aims, funded-project history and the merger of MND Research Australia into MND Australia.
care_team_notes: Use this for background on the Australian research ecosystem; do not treat grant program aims as evidence that a treatment is clinically proven.

name: Currently funded MND research
description: Detailed list of currently funded Australian MND research projects, institutions, project titles, grant types and research summaries.
care_team_notes: Useful for explaining research directions such as biomarkers, translation, models of care, symptom management and biomedical discovery.

name: MiNDAus Registry
description: Australian registry information for improving MND data, surveillance, research participation understanding and national knowledge about MND.
care_team_notes: Explain registry participation separately from clinical-trial participation; route consent and participation questions to the official registry/team source.

name: FightMND funded research projects
description: FightMND-funded clinical trials, drug development projects and impact grants, including historical research investment and project categories.
care_team_notes: Use for research landscape and funded-project context; verify trial status from current clinical-trial sources before discussing availability.

name: Australian Clinical Trials registry entry point
description: Australian government clinical-trials information entry point for learning about clinical trials, searching for studies and understanding participation.
care_team_notes: Use as a navigation source; for specific MND studies, cite the official trial record or MND Australia clinical-trials page.

name: Clinical trial answer boundaries
description: Instructional record for answering trial and emerging-treatment questions: cite source status, date, phase, location and eligibility caveats; do not recommend enrolment or claim benefit.
care_team_notes: Always separate approved treatment, symptom care, experimental trial participation and research news.

name: MND research statistics
description: Research and impact statistics from MND Australia, including funded projects, grants and research ecosystem measures where provided.
care_team_notes: Use only for broad research context and avoid converting funding statistics into clinical claims.
